description: Maker of MEATER wireless smart meat thermometers — app-connected probes that monitor internal and ambient temperature for grilling, smoking and roasting, sold direct through meater.com.

evidence.summary: MEATER's own CJ Affiliate program copy, reproduced on its network listing: 'earn 10% commission for new customers, no cap on commission, aim for the stars, 45 day cookie window' — an explicit no-earnings-cap statement in the program's own terms, with application via CJ Affiliate.
Lasso's affiliate directory corroborates the MEATER program at 10% per sale with a 45-day cookie.

Program copy describes MEATER content and insider access, creative inventory (videos, banners, product and food imagery), beta access to new app features and an affiliate portal for tracking clicks, referrals and commissions.

name: MEATER

reasons.compensation: Published 10% per sale on CJ with an explicit 'no cap on commission' statement in the program's own copy — verified uncapped.
reasons.contact_access: Open application through CJ Affiliate with an affiliate portal and program support, but no public partnerships email.
reasons.credibility: Established smart-thermometer brand (Apption Labs) sold direct and through major retailers.
reasons.niche_fit: Connected kitchen tech with a strong grilling/BBQ creator scene on TikTok and YouTube — squarely in the technology/home creator niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Publicly listed and open to apply through CJ Affiliate.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program supplies video and food-imagery creative and recruits content creators, though no formal ambassador structure is published.

description: Multinational technology company selling GPS smartwatches, fitness trackers, cycling computers, handheld GPS and automotive navigation devices direct through garmin.com.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's network directory lists Garmin's affiliate program on CJ Affiliate at 2% per sale with worldwide regions.

Rates conflict across sources: Creator Hero reports up to 8% via CJ Affiliate and FlexOffers and 1.6% via other routes, while the network directory lists 2% via CJ — so no single commission rate could be verified and commission_rate is null.
Uppromote's directory describes Garmin's performance-based CPS program as managed through third-party networks (CJ Affiliate, FlexOffers) with a 20-day cookie and monthly payouts.

name: Garmin

reasons.compensation: A program exists on CJ Affiliate, but published rates conflict (1.6% to 8% depending on source/network), so the rate is unverified and compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: Application route exists through CJ Affiliate signup; no public partnerships contact is published.
reasons.credibility: Global technology brand founded in 1989, listed on the NYSE, selling through its own stores and major retailers worldwide.
reasons.niche_fit: GPS watches and outdoor/fitness tech are core creator-review territory across YouTube and TikTok.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to apply through CJ Affiliate with manual review.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Garmin works with creators and publishers through its network programs, but publishes no dedicated creator or ambassador program page.

description: Heritage drinkware and outdoor brand founded in 1913, maker of the viral Quencher tumblers, bottles, coolers and camp cookware, sold direct through stanley1913.com.

evidence.summary: Stanley's own affiliate page states 10% commission on all sales, a 30-day cookie, and a 5-step application through AvantLink, its affiliate network partner; qualifying sites explicitly include influencers and social media sites.
The same page promises premium commission rates for top-performing affiliates and a dedicated program manager; no earnings-cap statement is published, so commission_cap is unknown.

name: Stanley 1913

reasons.compensation: Published 10% commission on all sales via AvantLink on the brand's own page, with premium rates for top performers; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Public affiliate page with a clear AvantLink application route and a named program-manager perk.
reasons.credibility: Century-old brand (founded 1913) with mass retail distribution and one of the most recognized drinkware lines in the US.
reasons.niche_fit: Tumblers and drinkware are among the most creator-driven home/lifestyle categories on TikTok Shop and Reels.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through AvantLink from the brand's own site.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own affiliate page explicitly recruits influencers and social media sites, and Stanley products are a staple of creator haul and review content.

description: Direct-to-consumer sleep brand known for its flippable two-sided memory foam mattress, plus pillows, weighted blankets, toppers and bed frames, sold through laylasleep.com.

evidence.summary: Layla Sleep's own Awin merchant profile states the affiliate perks: 5% base commission on all referred sales, access to a creative library, and a named program contact (danielle@laylasleep.com) for product reviews and rate negotiation.

LinkClicky's directory corroborates a 5% per-sale commission for Layla Sleep; sources differ on the current network (older listings say ShareASale, current listings and FMTC place the program on Awin, merchant 76100).
Third-party roundups quote 6% or around 10% for Layla, conflicting with the 5% base rate on the brand's own Awin profile; the Awin profile figure is the one recorded.

name: Layla Sleep

reasons.compensation: Published 5% base commission on the brand's own Awin merchant profile, with higher rates negotiable; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: A named affiliate manager email (danielle@laylasleep.com) is published on the network profile — top-band contact access.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC mattress brand with national online sales and mainstream review coverage.
reasons.niche_fit: Mattresses and sleep products are a proven home-creator review category, though narrower than drinkware or pet.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Awin profile explicitly invites product-review partnerships and influencer negotiation, but no public ambassador program is published.

FlexOffers also carries the Sleep Number affiliate program with a 30-day cookie, confirming the program is distributed through major affiliate networks.

name: Sleep Number

reasons.contact_access: Application is through the Impact network listing; no public partnerships email is published.
reasons.credibility: Public company founded in 1987 with hundreds of branded retail stores across the US.
reasons.niche_fit: Smart beds and sleep tracking fit home-tech and wellness creator content, though ticket prices make content less frequent.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Listed on Impact and FlexOffers, open to publisher application.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program recruits publishers and reviewers through networks; no public creator or ambassador program is published.

description: US mattress and bedding brand selling cooling memory foam and hybrid mattresses, adjustable bases, pillows and sheets direct through ghostbed.com, with a 101-night trial and 20+ year warranty.

GhostBed runs its own partner program portal at affiliates.ghostbed.com; its published terms describe application, acceptance at GhostBed's discretion, tracked links and monthly commission payment.
A partnership listing quotes up to 2.4% for GhostBed, slightly below the 3% default on the Awin profile; the network profile figure is the one recorded.

reasons.niche_fit: Cooling mattresses and sleep products are a steady home-creator review category.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin and the brand's own partner portal.

description: Family-owned cast iron cookware maker founded in 1896 in South Pittsburg, Tennessee — skillets, Dutch ovens, griddles and bakeware sold through lodgecastiron.com and major retailers.

evidence.summary: Sovrn Commerce's merchant page states Lodge Cast Iron's affiliate program is joined exclusively through Sovrn Commerce with a 30-day cookie; commission rates vary and are shown only inside the Sovrn dashboard, so commission_rate is null.

Rateful's TikTok Shop data (30 days to Nov 3, 2026) estimates about 83% of Lodge Cast Iron USA's TikTok Shop sales came through affiliate creators' videos and LIVEs, showing heavy active creator selling on TikTok Shop.
Lodge runs a creator community on Cohley ('Join the Lodge Cast Iron Brand Community'), with new creator applications currently paused due to demand.

reasons.credibility: America's oldest cast iron maker, family-owned since 1896, with mass retail distribution including Walmart and Cracker Barrel.
reasons.niche_fit: Cast iron cooking is a staple of food and home creator content, and Lodge is the category's default brand.

description: Largest US pet retailer, selling pet food, supplies, grooming, training and veterinary services for dogs, cats, fish, birds and small pets through petsmart.com and roughly 1,600 stores.

evidence.summary: Impact's own advertiser listing shows two PetSmart programs: the standard affiliate program (Online Sale 2%, Services Booking 2%) and a separate PetSmart - Creator program paying 5% on online sales. The creator rate is the one recorded for this directory.
Third-party directories quote conflicting PetSmart rates (4.8% per Lasso, around 8% per Uppromote); these conflict with Impact's own listing and are not used.
An October 2026 rate audit reading merchants' own network profiles confirms PetSmart pays 2% to websites on Impact, with the 5% figure being its separate creator contract.

name: PetSmart

reasons.compensation: Published creator rate of 5% on online sales per Impact's own advertiser listing (standard affiliate rate 2%); no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Application through the Impact advertiser listing; manual review and no public partnerships email.
reasons.credibility: Largest specialty pet retailer in North America with roughly 1,600 stores.
reasons.niche_fit: The biggest US pet retailer covers every pet subcategory creators post about.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to apply through Impact, subject to manual review and brand guidelines.
reasons.ugc_evidence: PetSmart runs a dedicated creator contract on Impact (5% online sales), separate from its standard publisher program — direct evidence of structured creator work.

description: Canadian DTC pet brand selling single-ingredient natural dog chews — bully sticks, yak chews and salmon treats — through bullybunches.com.

evidence.summary: Bully Bunches' own affiliate page invites creators to 'earn up to 10% commission' via a personal code/link, with a 10% first-purchase code for followers, PayPal payouts, and requirements to hold an active social account and share photos/videos. 'Up to' is a rate ceiling, so no single rate is recorded.

The brand's Instagram ambassador search offers selected ambassadors a monthly box of chews (about $75 value) plus a 10% referral link, in exchange for monthly photo/video content and posts over a six-month term.
Brand profile describes Bully Bunches as a Shopify Plus DTC pet brand and lists support@bullybunches.com as its support contact.

name: Bully Bunches

reasons.compensation: The brand publishes 'up to 10%' commission — a ceiling rather than a confirmed base rate — so the rate is null and compensation scores mid-low.
reasons.contact_access: Public affiliate page with on-site signup plus a published support email.
reasons.credibility: Smaller DTC brand on Shopify Plus with a 67K-follower Instagram presence; no major retail distribution verified.
reasons.niche_fit: Natural dog chews are a highly demonstrable, pet-creator-friendly product category.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Affiliate signup is publicly open on the brand's own site; ambassador cohorts run on seasonal searches.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Structured ambassador searches with defined monthly content deliverables, plus an open affiliate program requiring creators to post photos/videos.
